notes: Item 19 contains 8 FPRs: FPR#1-7 cover franchised outlet gross revenue for 2025 (56 outlets), 2024 (50), 2023 (40), 2022 (28), 2021 (20), 2020 (14), and 2019 (4). FPR#8 covers the Jacksonville FL company/affiliate outlet (AU Hydro LLC, not franchised) for 2015-2025 with gross revenue, net profit, and adjusted net profit as if franchised. The FPR#1 table column header reads 'Gross Revenue in 2024' but the text clearly states this is 2025 data — treated as a labeling error in the source document. 'Total Gross Revenues' is the sum of Self Service revenue plus Wash-Dry-Fold revenue where reported; many outlets in earlier years did not report WDF (Note 5: not required for franchisees who signed before May 1, 2020). Outlet 8 in FPR#5 total shown as '308,096.76' without $ sign — extracted as $308,096.76. FPR#7 data presented in monthly format; annual totals used. Detailed 2025 P&L for Jacksonville location provided on pages 58-59.
